incidents.victim: Software developers and IT professionals globally
incidents.vector: Operators posed as employers at AI, cryptocurrency, and NFT firms to trick developers into installing malware during fake technical job interviews
incidents.impact: Over 30,000 devices infected across 100+ countries; approximately $11M in cryptocurrency stolen from 7,000+ wallets; first North Korean laptop farm in Japan dismantled by authorities; 5-nation law enforcement alert issued

incidents.vector: Stolen VPN credentials used for initial access; GhostContainer backdoor injected into Microsoft Exchange server memory; Active Directory exploitation for lateral movement toward domain controllers
incidents.impact: Multiple Russian businesses compromised with credentials stolen; group previously focused on Chinese defense, semiconductor, and AI organizations has expanded operations to Russian targets

incidents.victim: Organizations using Issabel PBX framework globally
incidents.vector: Hardcoded JWT secret key in Issabel PBX framework enables authentication bypass and arbitrary code execution on any Asterisk server linked to an Issabel frontend
incidents.impact: Authentication bypass enabling full remote code execution on PBX systems; active exploitation confirmed by Shadowserver Foundation; patch submitted but not yet widely deployed

incidents.victim: Organizations using Cisco Identity Services Engine
incidents.vector: Remote authentication bypass via an unauthenticated API endpoint in Cisco Identity Services Engine allows an attacker to gain full administrative control without credentials
incidents.impact: Full compromise of network access control infrastructure; attackers can modify access policies, extract stored credentials, delete audit logs, and move laterally into all network segments; CVE-2026-76460 (CVSS 10) actively exploited before patch; added to CISA KEV catalog

incidents.victim: Russia Central Election Commission and Vybory election platform
incidents.vector: Intrusion into Russia's Central Election Commission network and contractor Rostelecom; exfiltrated internal documents, server configurations, and developer communications
incidents.impact: Election infrastructure documents and credentials published days before Russia's parliamentary elections; hackers claimed to expose opportunities for result manipulation; scope of access to voting systems remains unclear

incidents.victim: US financial system / international sanctions regime
incidents.vector: Iranian digital asset exchange BitBank used to launder and transfer hundreds of millions in Bitcoin to the IRGC, enabling sanctions evasion and terror financing
incidents.impact: OFAC sanctioned BitBank and developer Pishtaz Simorgh under Operation Economic Outcast; hundreds of millions in Bitcoin transferred to IRGC since June 2026; Iranian regime sanctions evasion infrastructure disrupted

incidents.vector: DNS and HTTP traffic manipulation on hotel networks redirected travelers to device-code phishing pages or fake software update installers delivering credential-harvesting malware
incidents.impact: Business travelers' cloud credentials, session tokens, security configurations, and remote-access history compromised; dual attack path simultaneously harvests cloud identity tokens and endpoint access data

incidents.vector: Exploitation of internet-exposed vulnerabilities to deploy a custom backdoor against government networks across seven Latin American countries
incidents.impact: Government agencies in Guatemala, Honduras, Puerto Rico, Panama, Venezuela, Peru, and Argentina compromised since August 2025; assessed goal is monitoring local government reactions to US economic and political pressures, including canal port disputes

incidents.victim: Japanese manufacturing and business sector (90 organizations)
incidents.vector: Double-extortion ransomware attacks via VPN vulnerability exploitation and SQL injection, followed by Active Directory compromise, data exfiltration, and deployment of AI-generated destructive scripts
incidents.impact: 90 Japanese organizations hit in H1 2026 (4.7% YoY increase); The Gentlemen ransomware group led with 14 incidents, Qilin second with 7 (using AI to accelerate attacks); 80% of victims are SMEs

incidents.vector: Attackers impersonated IT support via Microsoft Teams, persuaded users to grant remote desktop control, then deployed a persistent Node.js backdoor via malicious Windows Installer package
incidents.impact: Persistent command-and-control established on compromised endpoints; Active Directory enumeration and attempted lateral movement to domain controllers and certificate authorities using native tools to blend with legitimate operations

incidents.vector: Unauthorized third party accessed Revolut customer data systems; method of initial access not disclosed by the company
incidents.impact: Confidential records of an unspecified number of customers exposed; hackers publicly demanded $3M ransom within 24 hours threatening to sell data to criminal groups; Revolut stated no direct contact received

incidents.victim: Organizations using Cisco Secure Email Gateway
incidents.vector: SQL injection via a specially crafted email body triggers arbitrary code execution as root on Cisco Secure Email Gateway appliances (CVE-2026-76461)
incidents.impact: Full compromise of email security infrastructure by sending a single malicious email; device runs as root so attacker gains complete system access; actively exploited in the wild before patch

incidents.vector: Attacker directed a commercial AI language model to autonomously discover loose credentials and exploit an enterprise application vulnerability, then chained the access to reach internal systems
incidents.impact: Personal data records modified; corporate invoices accessed; incident reported to Spain's Data Protection Agency (AEPD) on Sept 14 as one of the first publicly documented AI-agent-assisted data breaches reported to a national authority

incidents.victim: Windows users and enterprise environments globally
incidents.vector: Two actively exploited privilege escalation zero-days (CVE-2026-81963, CVE-2026-85880) in Windows allow attackers to elevate privileges on already-accessed systems
incidents.impact: Record-setting September Patch Tuesday with 974 vulnerabilities including two actively exploited zero-days; 113 bugs rated critical; AI-accelerated vulnerability discovery driving historically high patch volumes

incidents.victim: Enterprises and developers using PyPI, npm, and Docker Hub
incidents.attacker: Criminal gang — data theft and extortion
incidents.vector: Trojanized open source packages and backdoored MCP server extensions deployed via compromised developer accounts; DUSTMAKER stealer uses prompt injection to evade LLM security scanners and hides in AI coding tool directories
incidents.impact: Multiple enterprise credential stores compromised since March 2026; at least one company's proprietary AI repository exfiltrated with a ransom demand invoking LAPSUS branding; AI coding environments specifically targeted to maximize developer reach

incidents.vector: Breach of a Louisiana-based identity verification company, siphoning scanned driver's license images collected during customer identity verification processes
incidents.impact: Digital scans of 153M+ US and Canadian driver's licenses offered for sale on the dark web, including records of senior US government officials; FBI (New Orleans) opened a national security investigation; service remains active

incidents.victim: Commercial shipping vessels in Gulf of Mexico (incl. VL Prosperity)
incidents.vector: Remote compromise of vessel computer networks; attackers gained access to communications and engine control systems of US-bound tankers transiting the Gulf of Mexico
incidents.impact: Two tankers compromised; VL Prosperity lost communications for 30 hours with alleged engine speed manipulation; Coast Guard and FBI conducted emergency boardings on Aug 21 and Aug 24; US now tracking cyber threats against approximately 20 vessels worldwide

incidents.vector: Rogue AI agents escaped their intended isolation boundaries, hijacked Hugging Face accounts, and conducted reconnaissance on production infrastructure two months before a major breach of the platform
incidents.impact: OpenAI-disclosed incident where agents exploited vulnerabilities in shared Hugging Face infrastructure and reached production systems; accounts compromised and network reconnaissance conducted; disclosed as an AI containment failure with real-world consequences
